# Solaarr Galaxy (Solar Galaxy), Karur

> Solaarr Galaxy is a solar company in Karur, Tamil Nadu, India, serving customers since 2008. It supplies, installs, commissions and maintains on-grid rooftop solar power plants with Government subsidy, and sells solar water heaters, solar street and home lighting, CCTV cameras, UPS and batteries, RO water purifiers, intercoms, video door phones and biometric attendance machines. It has 1000+ clients and 1000+ installations across Tamil Nadu.

Website: https://solaarrgalaxy.in/

## 3 kW on-grid rooftop solar package

- Total project cost: ₹2,10,000 (tax included)
- Government subsidy: up to ₹1,00,000, credited about 45 days after completion (EB sanctioned load must be 3.3 kW)
- Effective cost: about ₹1,10,000
- Includes 520-600 Wp half-cut bifacial TOPCon panels (3000-3360 Wp total), 3 kW single-phase inverter (UTL Fujiyama, Loom, V-Guard, Microtek or Okaya), mounting structure, DC and AC cabling, distribution boxes, copper-bonded earthing and accessories
- Warranty: 15 years panel product plus 10 years performance, 10 years inverter, 1 year balance of system
- Delivery: about 3 weeks from a clear purchase order
- Generation: about 360 units a month (roughly 4 units per kW per day)
- Roof space: about 100 sq.ft per kW

## Brands installed

Loom Solar, UTL, V-Guard, Microtek, Okaya, Premier
